test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

The policeman told the boys that they could not park their car there.

options.text: The policeman said to the boys, "You could not park their car there."
The policeman said to the boys, "You cannot park your car here."
The policeman said to the boys, "How could you park your car here?"
The policeman told to the boys, "They could not park their car there."

solution:
The correct answer is **The policeman said to the boys, "You cannot park your car here."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• This sentence is given in the **modal auxiliary **form.
 
• **'Can' **will be changed to '**could' **in reported speech.
 
• **'Told'** changes to **'said to'.**
 
• **Reporting verb** is changed according to the form and sense of the sentence.
 
• **Inverted commas** are added in the direct speech.
 
• In the direct speech, '**you' **is used for '**the boys'**. therefore, '**you' **is replaced by '**they' **in indirect speech. 
 
• Similarly, **'their' **is changed to **'your'.**
 
• **'There' **changes to **'here'.**
 
• **​**Thus, the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence is given in **option 2**.

**Correct Direct form:**__ *The policeman said to the boys, "You cannot park your car here."*
